title: Pure Mist Silk Mist 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Silk Mist offers a smooth and mild tobacco flavour, perfectly suited for vapers who prefer a lighter, refined tobacco profile. Inspired by low-tar cigarettes, this e-liquid provides a familiar and satisfying vaping experience. The Pure Mist High-PG collection caters to different vaping styles with its tailored VG/PG ratios. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Silk Mist is made in the UK with high-quality ingredients to ensure consistent satisfaction.
